name: Tofu Chocolate Mousse
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 340 g (12 oz) semi-sweet chocolate, chopped, or dark chocolate chips (see Note)
1 package (349 g / 12.3 oz) firm silken tofu (see notes)

steps: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler.
Empty the tofu into the blender and pulse several times.
Transfer all chocolate from double boiler to blender.
Blend until smooth and thoroughly combined. Stop blender and scrape sides with spatula if necessary.
Transfer to single dish or individual serving bowl. Chill in refrigerator for 6–8 hours or overnight. (See Note)

culture.text: A mousse is a soft, prepared food that incorporates air bubbles to give it a light and airy texture. Depending on preparation techniques, it can range from light and fluffy to creamy and thick. A mousse may be sweet or savory.
